payload.title: Add ChatGPT subscription transcription choice and default to API
payload.description: Classic-only host transport using the proven Electron Chromium request and existing account-bound OpenAI OAuth; canonical engine selection and jobs in Rust. Three engines: API(default), ChatGPT login, local. Preserve chunk checkpoints/resume and cancellation, disclose estimated timing for text-only ChatGPT results and avoid asserting specific billing guarantees.
acceptance: Three canonical persisted engine options with API fallback for projects lacking an explicit preference; preserve legacy job engine.
ChatGPT transcription uses existing account-bound OAuth and Chromium networking with bounded requests, cancellation, sanitized errors and no secrets in project/browser/logs.
Text-only output receives explicitly estimated timing via Rust, short bounded sections feed existing durable checkpoints without dropped progress.
Registry state/undo tests, meaningful host transport tests, typecheck, regenerated WASM and live UI selection verified.
